title: file cheatsheet how-to
desc: T2 usage recipes for wkappbot file tools: read/write/edit, glob, grep, batch edits.
steps: READ WRITE EDIT: wkappbot file read PATH; wkappbot file write PATH with content; wkappbot file edit auto-creates a .bak backup and is encoding-safe (use it instead of sed or awk for multi-file or CP949-risky edits).
GLOB: wkappbot file glob MUST use the double-star slash prefix to recurse; without it only the top directory matches.
GREP: wkappbot file grep with a regex and a path searches in-process; it is the robust fallback when the built-in Grep fails under load (see the ref tier).
BATCH MULTI-FILE: prefer wkappbot file edit or wkedit for atomic multi-file edits; never use python or sed for batch source edits because of CRLF and encoding corruption.
author: claude
